note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording (and the OT renderings made in its register).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' where Bounds elides. Bounds quotes the KJV; where OWB's wording changed a word his next sentence picks up, that sentence follows OWB (James 5:16's 'availeth much' «ብዙ ነገርም ማድረግ ይችላል», Romans 15:30's 'strive' «በትግሌ», the 'watch' of chapter 12 «ንቁ», 1 Samuel 15:22, Luke 19:21, Isaiah 64:7). Recurring verses read identically everywhere (Mark 11:23-24, 1 John 3:22, 1 Timothy 2:8, Luke 18:1, Ephesians 6:18). Per the founder rules: 1 Thessalonians 5:17 is «መጸለይን አታቋርጡ», and Paul's 'Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?' is quoted from Acts 22:10.

`self_rendered` rows: three re-personed recitations in chapter 9 (OWB's words in the third person); two critical-text cases the author argues from — 'prayer and fasting' (Matthew 17:21 / Mark 9:29) and Revelation 22:14 'do his commandments' — rendered from the English; and allusions.
